hero.title: Fuller classes.
hero.lead: When someone drops out, LevApp invites whoever is free and fills the spot for you. Reminders, attendance and invitations handled on their own. You handle the training.

wide.title: Fewer hours on the phone, every day
wide.body: LevApp knows who is free at each time and invites only them. No more messages to people who can't come and answers that never arrive.
checks: Invitations only to who is free
You step in only when needed

full.title: Fuller classes
full.body: It knows who will miss a class and fills every spot automatically. And it finds students looking for classes.

level.title: More competitive classes
level.body: LevApp finds the right student for the right spot: same level, same side of the court — or whatever rule you set.

attendance.label: A class's participants and invitees in LevApp
attendance.onlyFree: Only people with no block at this time

notices.title: Notices arrive through the app, not WhatsApp.
notices.body: Every invitation arrives as a notification and stays in the chat with the coach. The student answers Yes or No and gets the confirmation at once. No more groups where everything gets lost.
checks: Yes or No, in one tap
notices.label: A LevApp invitation on the lock screen and in the chat with the coach

newStudents.title: New students, from people already on LevApp.
newStudents.body: Players with a LevApp account can ask to join your academy's training or book private lessons with you. You decide who you accept.
newStudents.label: Student requests in LevApp

bookings.title: You keep booking courts as always.
bookings.body: LevApp is not a booking system and doesn't replace what your academy already uses. It handles the classes: who comes, who misses and who takes the spot.
checks: Classes, attendance and invitations in LevApp
bookings.label: The academy's booking system next to the classes in LevApp

how.title: LevApp adapts to your academy
how.lead: You don't need to be technical or change everything you have. LevApp fits your workflow.

steps.title: Set-up done by our team
steps.body: A LevApp team does the set-up for you. Just ask.

steps.title: It understands your calendar and students
steps.body: An app that understands your calendar and students if you send it the usual spreadsheets you work with.

steps.title: Simple or advanced, your way
steps.body: A system as simple as you want, as complex as you need.

import.title: Ready to use with the sheet you already have.
import.body: Upload the file you already use, in Excel, CSV or PDF, and LevApp's AI extracts players, levels, classes and evaluations. If you prefer, our team does the set-up for you.
checks: Excel, CSV, PDF or another document
No typing students in by hand
import.label: Importing data in LevApp
import.cardBody: Upload a file and let the AI extract your levels, players, classes, evaluations and more.
import.drop: Drop a file to import data
import.dropSub: Supports CSV, Excel, PDF or any structured document

results.title: Time goes back to the court.
results.note: Results seen in our first pilot project. They may not hold for every coach.
results.quote: “I used to spend the evening sending messages to fill the next day's classes. Now I open the app, see what's missing and it's sorted.”

cta.title: Ready for fuller classes?
cta.body: We show you LevApp with your academy's real timetable. 20 minutes, no commitment. During the pilot you pay nothing.

alt.hero: LevApp on a laptop, a phone and a watch
alt.benefits: LevApp messages on a laptop and a phone
alt.how: Attendance in LevApp on a laptop and a phone

board.label: LevApp tactical board: game situation, step 2 of 3, with team A, team B and the ball
board.title: BOARD
board.caption: Tactical board in the app. Draw drills, save them in the Training tab and show the plays on the tablet during class. Goodbye magnetic board.

demo.caption: You handle the training. LevApp handles the spot.

0.title: I can't make it today.
0.body: Pedro opens today's class in LevApp and taps "Not going". The coach knows right away.

1.title: A spot opened up.
1.body: Pedro becomes "Missed" and the spot is free. LevApp finds who has the right level and is free at 18:00, and sends the invitations by itself.

2.title: An invitation arrives.
2.body: Ana was still waiting for an answer from the club. She gets the LevApp notification and taps to open it.

3.title: Yes, I'm in!
3.body: She answers Yes in the chat. The first to accept gets the spot.

4.title: Class full.
4.body: Ana joins the list as "Going" and the class is 4/4, without the coach sending a single message.
